The organ features multiple groups of vertical metallic pipes of varying heights, arranged symmetrically around a central taller cluster. The pipes have a reflective blue-grey metallic finish. The instrument is housed in a dark, carved wooden case with decorative elements. Tall, branching columns and stained glass windows are visible in the background, framing the organ.
